title: Treatise on the Resin-Tipped Dart
summary: Teaches coating, curing and barbing darts with resin and driving them into hide with a qi-fed blow.

title: Handbook of the Long Blowpipe
summary: Shows how to carry, rest and shoot a long blowpipe for far targets with a qi-driven dart.

title: Guide to the Moving Mark
summary: Trains the lead, the pivot and the timing needed to hit walking and running targets with darts.

title: The Hunter's Lung Discipline
summary: Builds lung stamina and stored qi breath for long stalks, deep blows and quick strings of darts.

title: Scattering Dart Rules
summary: Teaches fanned reloads, wide muzzle sweeps and the spreading blow that stings a whole group at close range.

title: Drill-Book of the Hidden Tube
summary: Teaches stowing a short tube out of sight and shooting from it unseen at close range.

title: Workbook of Breath in Motion
summary: Pairs breath with footwork so a shooter can blow accurately on the run, on slopes and while backing away.

title: A Short Treatise on Close Defence
summary: Teaches a blowgun shooter to fend off, strike with the tube and shoot point blank when caught close.
